name: active_injection
author_proposal: Operator liability and insurance, central-fund contribution during injection.

name: postclosure
author_proposal: Operator monitoring, verification, remediation and full damage liability, with financial assurance; pool design must address moral hazard.

name: long_term_stewardship
author_proposal: After predetermined performance conditions and sufficient funding, public or hybrid stewardship supports monitoring/remediation/damages and data/site management.
